implementation: cgroupRoot defaults to /sys/fs/cgroup and may name a delegated descendant. JS and Python canonicalize it, require it to remain inside cgroupfs and require ownership by the current effective uid; nobody cannot substitute the root-owned cgroup.

Python additionally reads /proc/self/cgroup and refuses MIGRATION_LINUX_QUARANTINE_SUPERVISOR_OUTSIDE unless the supervisor is already inside the delegated root or its descendant. This is required because process migration permission is evaluated against the common ancestor, not only the child directory's mode bits.

The test provisioner chowns only the transient delegated directory and its cgroup.procs, then moves the test shell into that cgroup before setpriv to nobody. No permanent account, service, sudo rule or system-wide delegation is installed.
The E82 pre-exec membership, cgroup.kill, empty-procs receipt, explicit rmdir and three false external-exclusion fields are unchanged.
testRuns: systemd-run --scope --uid=nobody -p Delegate=yes was probed first: the scope directory remained root-owned and nobody could not mkdir below it. This was not counted as non-root evidence.

A root-created transient delegated directory allowed nobody to create and remove child cgroups. A later preexec_fn failure showed that directory ownership alone was insufficient; chowning the parent's cgroup.procs still did not authorize a supervisor outside the delegated root.
The test's implicit global crypto dependency was exposed by the cleared nobody environment and fixed with an explicit node:crypto randomUUID import before isolation behavior was retested.

After the test shell entered the delegated root before dropping privileges, the nobody suite passed 4 tests with 1 skip. Three consecutive runs plus the final run have the same result; the root regression also passes 4 with 1 skip. Logs: tmp/integration/migration-linux-quarantine-e83/root-final.log and nobody-final.log.
Final cleanup checked empty child procs, removed the delegated root and found no E83 cgroup residue. Remote and local SHA-256 values match for both production modules and the test.

Local related combination: 101 tests, 90 pass, 0 fail, 11 skipped. check:client and all 26 documentation tests pass. Final npm test: 1910 tests, 1836 pass, 0 fail, 74 skipped (tmp/integration/migration-linux-quarantine-e83/root-final.log).
